modules.name: Tectonic
modules.description: Earth: mining, and the Mass Driver orb mode.

badge.name: Drill Head
badge.description: +2 mining speed. Unlocks the Mass Driver mode: lift a block, charge it, and send it homing at what you aim at. It hits mobs harder the harder the block is, or places itself on the face you aim at.

commons.name: Spin-Up
commons.description: The mining ramp builds 20% faster.

commons.name: Collector
commons.description: Dropped items go straight to your inventory.

adept.name: Area Bore
adept.description: The beam mines a 3x3 face.

adept.name: Momentum
adept.description: Mining the same block type in a row builds speed, up to +30%.
ranks: Up to +80%, and the bonus survives a 2s break.

adept.name: Precision
adept.description: Soft blocks (dirt, sand, gravel, leaves) break 50% faster.

master.name: Fortune
master.description: Extra ore drops, like Fortune III.

master.name: Silk Touch
master.description: Blocks drop themselves.
ranks: Also picks up chests, barrels and shulker boxes with their contents inside.

master.name: Auto-Smelt
master.description: Ores and sand drop smelted, with XP.

grandmaster.name: Vein Miner
grandmaster.description: Breaking an ore breaks the whole vein, up to 64 blocks.

grandmaster.name: Ore Sense
grandmaster.description: Ores within 8 blocks glow through walls, fainter with distance and with blocks in the way.

grandmaster.name: Void Filter
grandmaster.description: Junk (cobblestone, dirt, netherrack...) is destroyed instead of dropped.

modules.name: Gravitic
modules.description: Space: the Tether, and moving through the world.

badge.name: Graviton Core
badge.description: Unlocks the Tether orb mode, and +10% move speed while summoned.

commons.name: Soft Landing
commons.description: No fall damage right after a tether pull.

commons.name: Drift
commons.description: Much better air control after letting go of the rope.

adept.name: Swing
adept.description: Tether becomes a real rope: you swing under the hook and pump it by holding forward. Jump to let go and keep your momentum.
ranks: Sneak to reel in while swinging.

adept.name: Slingshot
adept.description: Letting go while reeling fires you past the hook in a quick burst.
ranks: No fall damage during the burst.

adept.name: Wall Grip
adept.description: When the reel stops at a wall, you cling there for 2s.

master.name: Weightless
master.description: A phase 3 Tether shot at a mob makes it levitate for 3s; fired at your feet, you float up for 2s, then fall gently.

master.name: Recall
master.description: The hook grabs mobs and items: light ones are reeled to you, heavy ones pull you to them.
ranks: Also grabs every item within 2 blocks of the hook.

master.name: Zipline
master.description: Hook a block, let go while sneaking, then hook a second block: a rope strings between them. Aim at it and hold Tether to ride it. Lasts 2 minutes, one at a time.

grandmaster.name: Singularity
grandmaster.description: Where the hook lands, mobs within 4 blocks are dragged into a pile for 3s.

grandmaster.name: Displacement
grandmaster.description: Hook a mob and sneak to swap places with it.

grandmaster.name: Hammer Throw
grandmaster.description: Hook a mob, hold to whirl it around you, and let go to throw it where you look.

modules.name: Hydraulic
modules.description: Water: the Water and Frost orbs, and a tank for Vacuum.

badge.name: Tank
badge.description: Unlocks the Water and Frost orb modes. Vacuum stores the water it drinks in a 4 bucket tank.

commons.name: Gills
commons.description: Water breathing while summoned.

commons.name: Slipstream
commons.description: Water and Frost orbs fly through water, with no range limit while in it.

adept.name: Reservoir
adept.description: Tank holds 8 buckets.

adept.name: Wellspring
adept.description: Each water tile Vacuum drinks stores 2 buckets.

adept.name: Pressure
adept.description: Water orbs knock mobs back hard and put out fire in 5x5.
ranks: Harder knockback, puts out fire in 7x7.
Even harder knockback, puts out fire in 9x9.

master.name: Helmsman
master.description: Water orbs steer toward your aim while they fly.

master.name: Quench
master.description: Water orbs turn lava they hit into obsidian or cobblestone, and put out burning mobs.

master.name: Permafrost
master.description: Frost bridges last 3x longer and never crack while you stand on them.
ranks: Frost orbs also freeze a 3x3 where they land.

grandmaster.name: Tidecaller
grandmaster.description: Phase 3 Water orbs carry you along their flight, like Riptide.

grandmaster.name: Wave
grandmaster.description: Phase 3 Water rolls along the ground as a wave that pushes mobs and items, then drains away.

grandmaster.name: Glacier
grandmaster.description: Frost bridges are 3 blocks wide.

modules.name: Photonic
modules.description: Light: the Light orb, seeing and finding your way.

commons.name: Lumen Trail
commons.description: While idle in Light mode, glowing arrows show the path you walked, pointing back the way you came (last 256 blocks).

commons.name: Night Optics
commons.description: Night vision while summoned.

adept.name: Prism
adept.description: Light orbs bounce 2 more times.
ranks: 4 more, and bounce lights last twice as long.

adept.name: Beacon Net
adept.description: Up to 4 bounce lights show as on-screen waypoints, for as long as the lights last.

adept.name: Dazzle
adept.description: A Light orb's impact blinds mobs within 3 blocks for 2s.
ranks: 6s, and blinded mobs lose track of you.

master.name: Flare
master.description: Light orbs make mobs within 12 blocks glow through walls.

master.name: Refraction
master.description: The beam passes through glass and ice and splits into 2 rays behind it.

master.name: Sunfire
master.description: The beam and Light orbs burn undead: +50% damage, and they catch fire.

grandmaster.name: Laser
grandmaster.description: The beam goes straight through mobs and hits everything in its line.

grandmaster.name: Lodestar
grandmaster.description: A phase 3 Light orb fired straight up hangs there as a marker you can see from anywhere in the dimension, for 20 minutes (one at a time).

grandmaster.name: Sunburst
grandmaster.description: A phase 3 Light orb bursts in a flash: undead within 8 blocks burn and invisible mobs show.

modules.name: Pneumatic
modules.description: Air: the Gust orb, and a stronger Vacuum.

badge.name: Bellows Core
badge.description: Unlocks the Gust mode: a wind blast that knocks back, pushes items and flips levers, doors, buttons and trapdoors. Vacuum reaches 2 blocks farther.

commons.name: Gale Step
commons.description: Double jump: jump again in mid-air for a burst of air under you.

commons.name: Tailwind
commons.description: Sprinting while summoned is 15% faster and leaves a wind trail.

adept.name: Updraft
adept.description: A Gust at your feet launches you 1.5x higher than a wind charge, with no fall damage from it.

adept.name: Blowback
adept.description: A Gust pushes you backwards as a 3 block dash.
ranks: 7 blocks, and it works in mid-air.

adept.name: Turbine
adept.description: Vacuum pulls items and XP from 1.5x as far.
ranks: 3x as far, and it pulls small mobs too.

master.name: Cyclone
master.description: A phase 3 Gust becomes a slow whirlwind that lifts mobs and items for 3s.

master.name: Deflector
master.description: A Gust reflects arrows and other projectiles; ghast fireballs fly back.

master.name: Compressor
master.description: Vacuum puts items straight into your inventory and packs 9 nuggets or ingots into their block.

grandmaster.name: Vortex
grandmaster.description: Holding Vacuum on mobs drags them in and spins them, hurting them every second; their drops come straight to you.

grandmaster.name: Stasis
grandmaster.description: Vacuum holds the mob you aim at in the air, helpless, for as long as you hold.

grandmaster.name: Shockwave
grandmaster.description: A phase 3 Gust knocks back every mob within 8 blocks and interrupts their attacks.

modules.name: Pyrotechnic
modules.description: Fire: the Lava and Ignite orbs, and a lava tank for Vacuum.

badge.name: Heat Core
badge.description: Unlocks the Lava and Ignite orb modes. Vacuum stores the lava it drinks in a 4 bucket tank.

commons.name: Ember Trail
commons.description: Fire orbs melt snow and ice they fly past.

commons.name: Deep Tank
commons.description: Lava tank holds 8 buckets.

adept.name: Controlled Burn
adept.description: Your fire never spreads or burns blocks.
ranks: Beaming your fire puts it out.

adept.name: Kiln
adept.description: Lava and Ignite impacts smelt dropped items in 1 block.
ranks: In 5x5, and they cook food too.

adept.name: Fire Ward
adept.description: Your own fire and lava never hurt you; other fire hurts half as much.
ranks: Other fire hurts a quarter as much.

master.name: Forge Heart
master.description: Lava orbs that hit a furnace, smoker or blast furnace fuel it for 32 items.

master.name: Obsidian Cast
master.description: Lava globs harden into obsidian after 10s.

master.name: Incendiary
master.description: Ignite sets mobs on fire for 8s; phase 3 lays fire in a 4-point star, arms 2 blocks long.

grandmaster.name: Heat Ray
grandmaster.description: The beam sets mobs on fire and lights candles, campfires and TNT it touches.

grandmaster.name: Meteor
grandmaster.description: A phase 3 Lava glob fired upward falls back as a meteor on the block you aimed at.

grandmaster.name: Phoenix
grandmaster.description: Once every 10 minutes, a fatal hit while you burn leaves you at 4 hearts and bursts fire around you.

modules.name: Botanic
modules.description: Life: farming, and the Growth orb.

badge.name: Gardener
badge.description: Unlocks the Growth orb mode, and the sneak beam tills and harvests 3x3.

commons.name: Replant
commons.description: Harvested crops replant themselves.

commons.name: Pollen Trail
commons.description: Growth clouds follow your aim twice as far.

adept.name: Lingering Bloom
adept.description: Growth clouds last twice as long and pulse twice as often.

adept.name: Groundskeeper
adept.description: The sneak beam shears leaves, vines, cobwebs and honeycomb safely.

adept.name: Sower
adept.description: The sneak beam on farmland plants seeds from your inventory in 3x3.

master.name: Bountiful
master.description: Crops drop extra, like Fortune for crops.

master.name: Rewild
master.description: Growth turns dirt to grass and spreads flowers.
ranks: Also spreads moss onto stone and cobblestone.

master.name: Gentle Hands
master.description: The beam never breaks crops that are not fully grown.
ranks: The beam sometimes grows unripe crops a stage.

grandmaster.name: Verdant Pulse
grandmaster.description: Phase 3 Growth orbs grow everything in 9x9.

grandmaster.name: Harvest Moon
grandmaster.description: The sneak beam harvests a 7x7 of mature crops.

grandmaster.name: Herder
grandmaster.description: The sneak beam feeds every animal in 5x5 for free, no food needed.

modules.name: Plasmic
modules.description: Energy: the beam as a weapon.

commons.name: Capacitor
commons.description: The combat ramp charges 20% faster.

commons.name: Focus Lens
commons.description: +1 beam range.

adept.name: Sustain
adept.description: The ramp decays half as fast off target.
ranks: Decays at a third of the speed.
Decays at a fifth of the speed.

adept.name: Arc
adept.description: At ramp level 2+, a second beam jumps from the target to 1 more mob.

adept.name: Leech
adept.description: Heal 10% of beam damage dealt.

master.name: Overload
master.description: Adds a 4th ramp level.

master.name: Ionize
master.description: Mobs hit by the beam take +20% damage from orbs.

master.name: Disrupt
master.description: The beam ignores and damages shields.
ranks: The beam also slows what it holds.

grandmaster.name: Annihilate
grandmaster.description: A kill at max ramp keeps the ramp for the next target.

grandmaster.name: Lock-On
grandmaster.description: The beam sticks to a target that stays inside a small cone.

grandmaster.name: Dissolve
grandmaster.description: Beam kills drop extra loot, like Looting III.

modules.name: Kinetic
modules.description: Motion: the charged orb, in every mode.

commons.name: Quick Charge
commons.description: Charge time -20%.

commons.name: Long Throw
commons.description: +16 orb range.

adept.name: Overcharge
adept.description: Phase 3 orbs are larger and hit x1.5.

adept.name: Split
adept.description: Phase 3 orbs split into 2 on release.

adept.name: Bank Shot
adept.description: Every mode bounces once off blocks; Light bounces once more.

master.name: Echo
master.description: Phase 3 impacts repeat 1s later at half strength.

master.name: Quick Draw
master.description: A tap fires at phase 2 strength instead of phase 1.
ranks: A tap fires at full charge.

master.name: Payload
master.description: Phase 3 Water, Lava, Frost and Growth orbs cover a 3x3.

grandmaster.name: Detonator
grandmaster.description: Tap LMB while an orb flies to burst it right there, with its full impact effect.

grandmaster.name: Seeker
grandmaster.description: Orbs curve gently toward the nearest mob.

grandmaster.name: Orbit
grandmaster.description: Hold a full charge for 3s and it circles you as a shield; release to fire it.

modules.name: Mechatronic
modules.description: Redstone: operating and inspecting machinery. Design preview; gameplay is not implemented yet.

badge.name: Redstone Mode
badge.description: Design preview. Tap the straight Beam to send a pulse; hold to supply continuous power. Hit a control to activate it. Sneak + right-click adjusts signal strength.

commons.name: Signal Trace
commons.description: Reveal the redstone and components actually reached by your signal, following their shapes in red through walls. The highlight lingers briefly after power stops.

commons.name: Readout
commons.description: Aiming at a component shows its signal strength and relevant settings.

adept.name: Latch
adept.description: The last targeted block stays powered after release. Powering another replaces it; tapping the same target switches it off.

adept.name: Oscillator
adept.description: Holding sends repeating pulses instead of continuous power. A tap still sends one pulse.

adept.name: Afterglow
adept.description: The targeted block continues emitting your signal briefly after you release the Beam.

master.name: Fine Contact
master.description: Supply power only through the face you hit, for precise input into tightly packed circuits.

master.name: Induction
master.description: Power the targeted block and its immediately adjacent mechanisms.

master.name: Penetration
master.description: Reach a redstone component behind a thin layer of solid blocks. An outline previews the target before firing.

grandmaster.name: Feedback
grandmaster.description: Signal Trace distinguishes components that received power from components that actually changed state.

grandmaster.name: Retrigger
grandmaster.description: Releasing a held Beam sends one final pulse after a short pause.

grandmaster.name: Capacitor
grandmaster.description: After you release the Beam, components reached by your signal remain powered briefly throughout the machinery.
